name: patentmcp
description: Patent-data MCP server — USPTO / Google Patents (BigQuery) / TIPO GPSS / EPO OPS. Search, retrieve, screen and stage prior-art artifacts. Runs as an isolated Docker container; transfers files via token-based download over a Unix socket.
instructions:
Pair with the **patentworks** skill (bundled via skillPaths; downloadable at /patentmcp/skills/patentworks.zip). It is the playbook for these tools — disclosure -> screening -> drafting, plus per-jurisdiction drafting rules — so load it before any patent search or drafting task.

DOMAIN KB (mcp-integration-standard R16): patentmcp self-ships its patent-practice knowledge base — call patentmcp_kb_query(q) BEFORE judgment-heavy steps (search-query design, source-ladder interpretation, screening calibration) to recall distilled, evidence-graded knowledge (API specs, search methodology, failure modes); patentmcp_kb_get(id) returns the full body. Read-only serving of the repo's ragbase store; a missing KB fails fast with KB_UNAVAILABLE + remedy.

patentmcp produced files are reachable on this host via:
  curl --unix-socket /home/pkcs12/projects/patentmcp/.run/patentmcp.sock http://patentmcp.local/files/{token}/blob/{rel}
(The {token} and {rel} placeholders come from each tool result's handle.)

PORTABLE FLOOR (mcp-integration-standard R17). Every produced artifact is ALSO reachable protocol-natively via MCP resources/read at patent://{token}/{rel} — no host socket or WebDAV needed; resources/list mirrors the live token store. patentmcp_init returns {doctrine, capabilities}: a machine-readable capability summary (transport / file ingress-egress / WebDAV state / companion / conditional families) whose endpoints are tagged visibility=container|host-visible so a container-only socket is never mistaken for a host-executable recipe. Delivery tools (cache_export) run a typed asset preflight — an empty working tree is refused with EXPORT_EMPTY, and optional content assertions (assert_min_files / assert_nonempty / assert_contains_rel) fail loud with ASSERTION_FAILED rather than shipping an empty deliverable.

The human landing page (install guide + live tool list + companion skill download) is served at GET / on the same socket, and through the gateway at /patentmcp. Companion skills are discoverable machine-readably (mcp-integration-standard R9.2, BOTH halves): GET /skills lists them by bare name ({ok,skills:[{name,file_count}],count}) and GET /skills/{name}.zip downloads that one — so a remote client with no appRoot (which cannot resolve the relative skillPaths) can discover the name before fetching, instead of having to know 'patentworks' in advance. Through the gateway those are /patentmcp/skills and /patentmcp/skills/patentworks.zip.

Introspection & lifecycle: GET /tools returns machine-readable tool schemas from the live FastMCP registry (JSON {tools:[{name,description,inputSchema}]}); GET /health (and back-compat alias /healthz) returns liveness ({ok,service,store}). Host-side recovery: scripts/patentmcp-self-heal.sh {--check|--heal} probes the UDS socket and recreates only the patentmcp-${USER} compose project when unhealthy (never spawns a competing daemon).

TWO PLANES (mcp-integration-standard R13). This server is a repoless NETWORK GATEWAY: it keeps only work that needs credentials or the network; deterministic post-processing runs as host-local landing scripts under the patentworks skill.

(a) COMPUTE PLANE — container MCP tools (network/credential): Search `patent_search` (the SINGLE search entry point, see below); single-document fetch epo_family / epo_biblio / gpatents_get / gpatents_download_pdf / gpatents_download_figure / uspto_patents (full-document methods) / ppubs_batch_get_claims / patent_get_claim1 / fetch_patent_pdf / patentmcp_batch_download_figures / google_get_patent / google_get_patent_claims / google_get_patent_description / google_budget_status; pool_fetch(publication_numbers[]) fetches per-pub pool metadata and returns a records JSON handle (the data half of the retired analyze_pool — render charts locally with pool_charts.py); WebDAV cache lifecycle cache_provision / cache_list / cache_export / cache_close (see WEBDAV below).

(b) LANDING PLANE — host-local skill scripts (deterministic, no network); call `python3 <script> --help` for the full contract: skills/patentworks/scripts/screening_build.py (records JSON -> family dedup -> column select -> CSV: --in/--out/--purpose/--extra/--exclude/--source); claims_tools.py (clean-html / extract-claim1 / claim1-empty over a claims block); search_audit.py (rigor gate over 01_search/matrix-log.jsonl: --log); figure_extract.py (PDF -> FIG.1 page -> PNG, needs poppler, MISSING_DEPENDENCY fail-fast); pool_charts.py (records JSON -> stat charts, needs matplotlib, MISSING_DEPENDENCY fail-fast); patentdb_local.py (local sqlite put / query / import-csv).

RETIRED (now return a typed TOOL_LANDED redirect envelope {success:false, error_code:'TOOL_LANDED', landing:{script, usage}} — they do NOT run the old logic; call the named landing script instead): build_screening_table -> screening_build.py; search_audit -> search_audit.py; patentdb_put/patentdb_query/patentdb_import_csv -> patentdb_local.py; extract_representative_figure -> figure_extract.py; patentmcp_analyze_pool -> pool_fetch (data) + pool_charts.py (charts). stage_file is RETIRED with no script replacement — provision a WebDAV cache (cache_provision) and PUT the file over the mount instead. Vendored landing-script libs stay in sync with src/_pure via scripts/sync_pure_lib.py (drift guarded by tests).

WEBDAV working cache (deliverable staging): cache_provision(subject_id, owner_identity) idempotently returns a mount_path + a ONE-TIME Basic credential (only its hash is stored). Credential bootstrap over the MCP rail (R14.6): pass issue_webdav_credential=true to mint-or-ROTATE this cache's credential and get the cleartext back once more — holding the MCP socket is the capability, no HTTP chicken-and-egg. WARNING: the flag rotates — any existing mount using the old password is invalidated; omit the flag and the payload is byte-identical to the pre-flag behaviour. Mount it with any WebDAV client (rclone/davfs2) using Basic auth username=owner_identity password=credential — the DAV face requires auth (no fallback; 401/403). Do byte-level staging (投料/取件) over the mount (PUT/GET/PROPFIND/MKCOL/MOVE/LOCK); when the deliverable is ready call cache_export(subject_id, target, owner_identity) to COPY-land it to a truth-store target (unreachable parent -> EXPORT_TARGET_UNREACHABLE). cache_close refuses while dirty (WORKSPACE_CLOSE_DIRTY + un-landed list) unless force=True. Do NOT put credentials into these instructions or any log.

Search: `patent_search` is the SINGLE search entry point. The source ladder is built into the server — TIPO GPSS (official, primary) > EPO OPS > USPTO PPUBS > (gated) Google Patents scraper — you do not pick a source; the server routes by credential availability and query-axis capability, and every level's attempt is recorded in the result's `provenance` array. The scraper tail only runs with allow_scraping=true (explicit user authorization); otherwise all-official-miss fails fast with error_code=SCRAPING_REQUIRED. Retired search tools (gpss_search / epo_search / gpatents_search / uspto_patents ppubs_search_*) are gone — call patent_search instead.

Bulk export: `patent_bulk_export` is the COMPLEMENT of patent_search — use it to exhaustively pull a WHOLE classification axis's bibliography in one call (AIOT/landscape sweeps), NOT to find the few most relevant hits. It takes a PURE classification axis (ipc/cpc/uspc, at least one; keyword is intentionally not accepted — no AND-narrowing that over-constrains the axis into false zero-hits), a large num (auto-paginated via expSkip, hard-capped at 5000) with the full expFld forced so no half-empty rows land. It is GPSS-only: an official miss is a TRUE zero (records=[], provenance reason=zero_hits) and NEVER falls back to the scraper (no SCRAPING_REQUIRED). Rows are absorbed into patentdb via COALESCE upsert, so re-running backfills previously half-empty rows (e.g. blank title_en) without clobbering. Choose patent_search for relevance, patent_bulk_export for coverage.

USAGE GUIDE: this service self-ships its full usage doctrine — call patentmcp_init (or prompts/get patentmcp_init) for organ-coordination, cross-tool tradeoffs, pre-call disciplines, and gotchas before first use.
